method_policy: Frozen existing source selector, BEB1 anchor, source-owned retirement, queried XY-graph admission, exact contact policy and component atomic union. No expanded theorem or relaxed contact policy.

segments.camera_evaluation: Saved original Blender BEZIER keyframes at 1,120,240,360,480, evaluated at absolute frames 97..160; do not replace by linear interpolation or new path.

visibility.sampling: 960x540 pinhole pixel centers, no AA, world-space flat normals, first face wins exact depth ties
visibility.candidate_denominator: All fixed source supports; uncompiled candidates use complete explicitly marked baseline candidate halo. Unknown support visibility is unknown, never zero.
visibility.event_visible_definition: At least one original-camera baseline support pixel at any active natural query
visibility.roi_rule: Union of baseline source and corresponding replacement visible support masks; full-frame and ROI metrics kept separate

post_displacement.gate: Only after all fixed segments have a complete screen or an explicit infrastructure stop, select the first qualifying component by the frozen rule.
post_displacement.method_inputs: Original per-element kernel evaluation at actual new-center position; original element identity and surface parameters; no invented attribute interpolation.
post_displacement.schedule: Selected component's original requested natural hit frames, immediate available neighbors and separate exact root; explicit finite schedule, not a whole displaced video.

small_visual_experiment.gate: Only a visible component that passes independently versioned post-displacement checks
small_visual_experiment.optional_diagnostic: C0 root-only; roots excluded from natural-frame denominators
small_visual_experiment.controls_contract: Reuse existing definitions where implemented. Any undefined control or unavailable reference is explicitly unsupported, not silently replaced. Freeze concrete controls/reference inputs before their quality outputs.
small_visual_experiment.quality_reference: Must be explicitly defined and independently bound before interpreting differences as errors or improvements; no baseline-relative difference is called improvement.
small_visual_experiment.warped_ssim: Optional secondary metric, never substituted for local support metrics

coverage.source_admission: joint admitted events / all canonical events, with unsupported and unresolved explicitly reported
coverage.visible_admission: visible admitted source events / visible candidate source events; null on denominator zero

budgets.cleanup: Remove only validated run-owned temporary cache copies and disposable coarse intermediates after input verification; preserve compact results and required rerun inputs. No environment deletion.

stop_rules: Input/provenance/identity mismatch or unexpected harness failure: stop that attempt; preserve error artifact, fix experiment wiring only in a fresh version, never change frozen scene or method to chase an outcome.
Budget exceeded: explicit infrastructure stop, no automatic budget/LOD/seed substitution.
No visible admitted events across all three fully evaluated segments: stop visual-improvement headline; do not switch to diagnostic cameras or silently add searched segments.
Post-displacement undefined inputs or failed boundary/contact contract: mark unsupported; no unverified RGB quality experiment.
